_comment: Plugins whose SKILL.md BODIES under skills/ together exceed 160,000 bytes (~40k tokens). A RATCHET: this number may fall, never rise. Read by pc_plugin_corpus in scripts/lib/plugin-checks.sh. Until 2026-11-12 the measure also counted references and read 1 (craft-layer); references are now reported by pc_plugin_refs as a WARN, because a reference costs context only when a body sends the model to read it, and counting them left task-runner 46 B and taskmaster 29 B under the cap, so every edit there became a compression pass. Measured 2026-11-12 on bodies: craft-layer 127,733 B, taskmaster 84,105 B, task-runner 64,343 B; none over. Never raise it to make a build pass.
